result.reason: The revision satisfies the fallback by covering affiliates without requiring notice and permitting transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction; it also appropriately covers contractors acting on Client’s behalf. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing use restrictions. It does not reach the preferred termination standard because Section 13 still permits non-renewal and termination for breaches not expressly required to be material, and “reasonable opportunity to cure” is less precise than termination solely for an uncured material breach. No perpetual/irrevocable treatment is provided for any paid-up licence. Drafting is generally professional, but the termination cross-reference is internally imprecise.
